changed: ui-core conversation state behind features.conversations. The client gains getMemberFeatures, createConversation, listConversations, getConversation and postMessage; request() no longer throws on a plain-text 405. The controller reads the mode from /v1/me/features. In off, and in the per-run view of shadow, it keeps today's behaviour. Shadow and on post through the conversation route; on lists server threads, newest first. selectThread builds the thread only from server snapshots and run events (AG-FE-2, EA-1). A refused message keeps the draft and shows the server's fixed hint, mapped to i18n keys (EN and VI from research 20), with the server text as the fallback. /v1/runs or /inputs is used only when features report off, or when a route answers 404 or 405 without the error envelope, and then with a fresh key. In on, an enveloped NOT_FOUND is shown, keeps the draft and re-reads features, and nothing is re-posted. An answer carries the run revision shown with its question. Review fixes: in on, an answer to a legacy unlinked run goes through /inputs with no conversation created (C3-1). conversation.compared, context_carried and shadow_failed are known and hidden (HIDDEN_EVENT_TYPES); they still advance lastSequence (C3-2). A pending message blocks a different text with error.pending and survives New task (C3-3). Real-client tests cover the error bodies (C3-4). Commits 89112fff and 4682f487. Reviews 4e.3.json (rework) and 4e.3-r2.json (accept). make e2e: 168 passed, 4 skipped.
